faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Hub Freehub Body Spline suitable for Freehub body anti-bite spline strip?
faq.a: Titanium Hub Freehub Body Spline uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address wheel hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Hub Freehub Body Spline?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Hub Freehub Body Spline is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for freehub body antibite requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Hub Freehub Body Spline require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. freehub body antibite components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for freehub body antibite application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.
